scope: Implementation and validation addendum; historical evidence is preserved, not rewritten.  Source merges do not establish runtime or physical-device acceptance.

dependencySecurity.verification: Fresh GitHub Dependabot REST query after merge; snapshot on 2026-09-11

additionalIssues.summary: Preserve exact VPS lease ownership across delayed final screenshots so the workspace SSH alias guard remains effective
Make the on-demand Mac updater preserve active work and support staged installation and rollback
Reduce full application CI for documentation-only closeouts while preserving required gates
Missing room Stop control in the iOS companion
Docs/test dependency security updates discovered during the audit remediation

findings.title: Packaged fallback can create a second harness against the shared data root
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Use the normal update lifecycle to stop legacy harness binaries, then verify a single live data owner and authenticated attachment.  Existing legacy processes do not cooperate with the new lock; final inspection reproduced two PIDs sharing the same database/WAL on the older runtime.

findings.title: Static harness attachment has no build or API compatibility check
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Add authenticated build/API compatibility identity and reject incompatible attached builds.

findings.title: Initial renderer hydration swallows all REST failures
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Surface partial REST hydration failures and provide bounded recovery independently of SSE connectivity.

findings.title: Automatic-update setting gives no failed-save or HTTP-status feedback
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Check failed HTTP saves, preserve the persisted update preference, and show a retryable save error.

findings.title: Validate desktop reconnect cleanup and accessible failure announcements
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Validate reconnect cancellation and VoiceOver announcements for critical failures.

findings.title: Repair PagerDuty delivery to the authenticated webhook ingress
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify Cloudflare authenticated ingress and PagerDuty receipt-to-run delivery with controlled external evidence.

findings.title: Restore Composio connectivity and report configured versus usable status separately
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Separate configured credentials from connected-tool usability; verify an actual permitted tool operation.

findings.title: Bound fleet RAG fallback and honor explicitly selected service routes
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Bound recall fallback and honor explicit service routes; compare CLI and protected MCP behavior.

findings.title: Do not report RAG ready when backend or protected-route checks fail
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Check protected route and backend readiness separately; do not infer readiness from public health.

findings.title: Validate Sentry redelivery identity and preserve existing PagerDuty deduplication
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Validate real redelivery identifiers and retain existing PagerDuty deduplication; no new PagerDuty duplicate bug is established.

findings.title: Add an operator acceptance matrix for builds engines and integration health
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Run a dated operator acceptance matrix on the deployed desktop, phone, engines, and protected integrations.

findings.title: Fallback outcomes mutate the primary engine's cooldown and attribution
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Confirm deployed fallback telemetry and cooldowns are attributed to the engine that executed the turn.

findings.title: Stall cancellation targets the original engine after failover
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Confirm deployed Stop/watchdog behavior cancels the actual owner without releasing a live process or a newer turn.

findings.title: Automatic failover is ordered, not healthy
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify deployed availability, authentication, quota, model capability, and cooldown filtering for fallbacks.

findings.title: Claude silently grants every globally configured MCP server to every bot
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify the deployed Claude CLI advertises strict MCP support and only selected integrations reach bot turns; helpers have no tools or MCP servers.

findings.title: Grok API duplicates the entire request context
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify a deployed Grok multi-turn/tool exchange without duplicated context; source request-body regressions cover the construction.

findings.title: Failed ACP or Codex resume silently drops conversation history
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Preserve resume failure explicitly instead of silently starting a fresh ACP/Codex conversation.

findings.title: ACP prompts have no driver-level deadline
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Add a bounded ACP prompt deadline and cancellation regression.

findings.title: Cost telemetry treats subscription-equivalent Claude cost as actual spend
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify the deployed Usage Monitor retains the equivalent as estimate metadata without adding it to actual spend.

findings.title: DSH is first-class in defaults but source main cannot launch its ACP backend
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Coordinate with the CLAUDE-owned DSH launch lane (#188); validate setup/auth and first-class dispatch.

findings.title: Antigravity quota keys cannot drive catalog-level routing
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Coordinate with the GROK quota lane; normalize Antigravity quota groups to catalog routing.

findings.title: Investigate routine failures and expose reliable execution outcomes
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Collect current routine failure samples and distinguish setup, provider, watchdog, and receipt outcomes.

findings.title: Restore a complete macOS updater feed and reconcile shipped build identities
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify the shipped release feed, update assets, and installed build identity; unsigned test artifacts are insufficient.

findings.title: Reconcile duplicate and stale board effort rows without losing ownership
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Reconcile remaining fleet board/effort drift without changing peer ownership; this batch closes only its own rows.

findings.title: Paired profile PATCH crosses its documented trust boundary
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Narrow paired profile PATCH fields to the intended trust boundary and reject execution-sensitive changes.

findings.title: Always Allow is offered by iOS but denied by the sidecar
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Resolve the Always Allow product/sidecar contract and align client behavior.

findings.title: Background APNs delivery navigates and can switch the Mac task without a tap
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify APNs background delivery does not navigate; only an explicit notification tap opens a task.

findings.title: Background fetch reports completion before reconnect or hydration completes
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Verify background completion on a device after awaited hydration; the deadline depends on cooperative cancellation.

findings.title: Send and Stop omit the server task-binding guard
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Validate captured task identity for bot Send/Stop on device; missing room Stop UI remains separately tracked in #310.

findings.title: iOS does not use the server send idempotency contract
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Validate stable request keys across ambiguous transport retries and committed replay after task switches on device.

findings.title: Accepted image formats cannot be read through the companion route
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Align companion image read formats with accepted uploads and test round trips.

findings.title: Editing an engine selection silently clears reasoning effort
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Preserve reasoning effort during engine edits; coordinate with adjacent model-settings work.

findings.title: Bot Settings dismisses after a failed save
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Coordinate with the AG-owned settings-save lane; dismiss only after confirmed save success.

findings.title: Live Activities are explicitly stale while the app is suspended
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Decide and validate suspended-device Live Activity behavior with APNs/device evidence.

findings.title: Remediate vulnerable Electron packaging dependencies and verify generated artifacts
findings.remainingAcceptanceOrWork: Dependabot refresh after #316 found zero open alerts.  Validate signed release/update behavior on an installed build; unsigned native packaging has passed on all three platforms.
